contour.description: An on-the-go EQ manager for USB DACs from CrinEar, FiiO, SnowSky, TRN, Moondrop, Kiwi Ears, JCally and Tanchjim. Keep all your EQ profiles on your phone, plug the DAC in, pick one and send it. Plug in, send, unplug - that is the whole routine. On DACs with their own settings, a DAC page changes those from the phone too.
